result.description: Unattended nightly suite, run against the local endpoint and used as the drift baseline. It differs from suites/baseline.json in breadth rather than depth: the same three procedures are performed across three unrelated policy domains -- parcel shipping, IT access control, and expense reimbursement -- because a control that holds in one domain and fails in another is the more informative result, while asking one scenario harder only narrows an interval around that one scenario. Every organisation, policy, and figure below is invented. Each source set is closed and self-contained, so an answer can be checked against it without reference to the world, and nothing here asserts anything about any real organisation. Two choices in the new citation cases are deliberate and worth not undoing. First, no question introduces a figure absent from its own sources: the screen treats an unsourced number as unsupported outright, so such a question would book an exception against a correct answer and feed noise into the drift signal this suite exists to produce. Second, each new case is twelve directly answerable questions, four answerable only by combining two sources, and four the sources genuinely cannot answer. Abstention is capped at four rather than pushed higher because it is detected by a fixed phrase list: correct refusals worded outside that list score as fabrications, and loading a quarter of the population onto that detector would let a change of wording, rather than a change of behaviour, decide the case.
